title: Pack 1 offline launch verification
notes: Cached the Leaflet 1.9.4 runtime and stylesheet in the PWA shell so the installed app can cold-launch after the network is disabled.
Split the testing app into a small HTML shell, external stylesheet, application runtime, data module, storage adapter, and provider adapter.
Combined the LSD converter runtime layers into one reusable converter bundle while preserving the authoritative offline Alberta ATS pack.
Removed duplicate legacy function declarations and the historical override stack from active runtime logic.
Removed the remote legacy 43 MB well-data HTML fallback. Well snapshot files now cache only when Wells needs them and can be reused offline after an online load.
Replaced native browser prompt and confirm dialogs with in-app field-friendly controls.
Removed placeholder settings rows and kept only settings that currently work.
Archived the standalone LandTracker reconstruction and removed obsolete recovery, diagnostic, scraping, and reverse-engineering workflows from the active project.
Added a React and TypeScript migration workspace plus typed converter, storage, and provider boundaries for later architecture packs.
Added a deployed Playwright regression gate that verifies the mobile app online and then reloads it offline and resolves a known LSD from the cached authoritative pack.
